experiment.name: mindboggle101_3d_unet_baseline_v1
experiment.purpose: Reproducible baseline segmentation experiment specification for the thesis; full training is not started by this configuration.

dataset.name: Mindboggle-101
dataset.task: T1 MRI -> manual DKT31 cortical segmentation

classes.mapping_policy: original DKT IDs map reversibly to contiguous classes 0-62 during training; predictions must map back to original DKT IDs for evaluation/visualization

split.participant_grouping_rule: All subject/acquisition records sharing a participant_group_id remain in one split; native and MNI152 representations remain together, with MNI152 eligible for training.
split.test_policy: Frozen test set is evaluated once only after final model/checkpoint selection; no test voxel data may be accessed during training preparation or model selection.

training.scheduler: none for initial baseline unless separately approved
training.early_stopping: not enabled by default; checkpoint selection uses validation metric policy

mixed_precision.reason: disabled until approved GPU environment verification

training.device_policy: CPU can run smoke tests; full training should use an approved NVIDIA GPU environment after Stage 6B decision.
training.determinism_policy: Use stable SHA-256 semantic seeds and torch deterministic settings where supported; do not use Python hash, filesystem order, worker ID, process ID, wall-clock time, or validation/test information for stochastic decisions.

patch_sampling.boundary_policy: constrained full in-volume patches; no padding

augmentation.default_in_code: disabled unless explicitly enabled for training
augmentation.final_training_policy: enable approved training-only augmentation for final baseline unless Stage 6B explicitly decides otherwise

disabled_operations.left_right_flip: disabled because DKT classes encode hemisphere and no atomic label-ID swap is approved

subdirectories.checkpoints: latest and best-validation checkpoints when full training is separately authorized
subdirectories.metrics: training/validation metrics and final test metrics after approved final evaluation
subdirectories.predictions: validation/test prediction outputs only when inference is separately authorized

unresolved_constraints: Dataverse v2 versus OSF v3 equivalence
